title: Remove wallpapers from 'dark stussy grunge' onward and set 'Cheetah B and W' as default

requirements.text: In the wallpaper list defined in usePersonalization.ts and PersonalizationPanel.tsx, find the entry named 'dark stussy grunge', remove it, and remove every wallpaper entry that appears after it in the list.

quotes: delete any wallpaper from dark stussy grunge
delete it along with every wallpaper that comes after it in the list

acceptanceCriteria: The wallpaper 'dark stussy grunge' no longer appears in the PersonalizationPanel grid.
All wallpapers that were listed after 'dark stussy grunge' no longer appear in the PersonalizationPanel grid.
Wallpapers listed before 'dark stussy grunge' remain unchanged.

requirements.text: Set 'Cheetah B and W' as the default background in usePersonalization.ts so that new visitors (with no localStorage preference saved) see the 'Cheetah B and W' wallpaper applied on first load.

quotes: make the default background cheetah B and W

acceptanceCriteria: When localStorage contains no saved background preference, the app renders with the 'Cheetah B and W' wallpaper active.
The 'Cheetah B and W' option is highlighted/selected by default in the PersonalizationPanel when no prior selection exists.

constraints: Do not remove any wallpapers that appear before 'dark stussy grunge' in the list.
Do not alter the backend schema or any Motoko files.
nonGoals: Changing the UI layout of the PersonalizationPanel.
Modifying any other personalization settings (e.g., overlay opacity).
